# darkf

> A small, typed workflow engine for agent + script state graphs — deterministic automation with LLM agents. Build a dark factory: most runs finish with nobody watching, and a run stops itself at the failing step and reports why instead of running on broken work.

darkf runs automation as a workflow: a typed TypeScript state graph describing steps and what happens next. Some steps dispatch an AI agent (Claude Code, OpenCode, or any custom `AgentRunner`); some steps are plain code. Every run is journaled to disk as it happens, so a finished, failed, or stuck run is answered by a file, not a terminal you forgot to watch.
